quote_zh: (1)与实施例1所述步骤相同，得到含量为98.2％的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐；
arithmetic_check: Nothing to check. The paragraph prints one number, the 98.2 percent content of the sodium benzoate salt, and no mass, no volume and no mole figure, so there is no mass/mole pair and no yield to close. The 98.2 percent is a content, not a yield. No arithmetic flag is raised, and the absence of a flag here means absence of printed numbers, not a check that passed.
drawing_evidence: None. This example draws no scheme for step (1); the only IMAGE_EXTRACT span in the section, at line 599, is the step (2) reaction scheme. Its single arrow starts from the sodium benzoate salt, which is this step's product, so the drawing corroborates the identity and the sodium counter ion of the product but says nothing about how step (1) was run. The lack of a drawing for step (1) is consistent with the step being a cross-reference to Example 1.

quote_zh: 向反应釜中加入100mL 2-四氢呋喃甲醇，开动搅拌，室温下投入5.5g金属钾(99％，0.14mol)，搅拌至溶解完全，经高真空油泵负压脱溶后得到2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钾固体，密封备用。
arithmetic_check: Potassium metal: 5.5 g printed at 99 percent strength with 0.14 mol. 5.5 g / 39.098 = 0.1406 mol taken gross, and 5.5 x 0.99 / 39.098 = 0.1393 mol taken on the stated strength. Both round to the printed 0.14 mol, so the pair implies an atomic weight consistent with potassium and no molar_mass_inconsistent arises. Tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol: 100 mL printed, with no mass and no mole figure, so there is no pair to check; at the usual density it is roughly a mole of alcohol against 0.14 mol of potassium, which is the large excess the procedure implies by stripping the excess off afterwards. No mass, yield or content is printed for the isolated alkoxide, so there is no product closure to test, and mass_balance_implausible cannot be evaluated on this step rather than having been evaluated and passed. No arithmetic flag is raised.
drawing_evidence: No arrow is drawn for this transformation. In the step (2) scheme at line 599 the alkoxide appears only as a condition on the arrow, described there as potassium (tetrahydrofuran-2-yl)methanolate drawn as a tetrahydrofuran ring carrying a CH2-OK group at its 2-position. That agrees with the prose, which makes the potassium alkoxide of tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol, so the counter ion in the drawing and the counter ion in the prose match. The scheme carries no charge, no temperature and no time for this preparation, which is why the record is built from the prose alone.

quote_zh: 将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为1h，加毕保温反应6h。
arithmetic_check: Stated input: sodium benzoate salt 0.1 mol at 98.2 percent content, so 0.0982 mol of contained salt; no mass is printed for it, so there is no mass/mole pair to test and molar_mass_inconsistent cannot arise for the charge. Stated output: 32.6 g of product at 97.0 percent by quantitative liquid chromatography, which is 31.62 g of 2-chloro-3-{[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-yl]methoxymethyl}-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, C14H17ClO6S, molecular weight 348.80, hence 0.0907 mol. Theoretical maximum from 0.0982 mol of contained salt is 34.25 g of pure acid, and the printed 31.62 g of contained product is below it, so the mass does not exceed what the input moles could give and mass_balance_implausible does not apply. Closure against the stated yield: 0.0907 / 0.1000 = 90.7 percent, against the printed two step yield of 90.8 percent, agreement to 0.1 percentage point, which is rounding. THE ARITHMETIC CLOSES. One observation, recorded and not flagged: the printed yield closes against the nominal 0.1 mol and not against the content corrected 0.0982 mol, which would give 92.3 percent, so the patent's own two step yield does not carry the 98.2 percent content into its basis; and the basis it names is the methyl ester, whose charge is never printed in this example, so the yield can only be tested on the assumption that the step (1) ester cleavage was quantitative on a 0.1 mol basis. No arithmetic flag is raised on this step.
drawing_evidence: The IMAGE_EXTRACT reaction scheme at line 599, step_id 1, is this step. Its reactant is CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)[O-])c(Cl)c1CBr.[Na+], C9H7BrClNaO4S, the sodium salt, matching the prose, which also says sodium; its conditions are the potassium alkoxide, drawn as a tetrahydrofuran ring with a CH2-OK group at the 2-position, and HCl, both of which the prose also has, with the same potassium counter ion; its product is CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)c(Cl)c1COCC1CCCO1, C14H17ClO6S, which is the free acid the prose names as the target compound. Drawing and prose therefore agree on both counter ions and on the acidification, so no drawing_text_conflict is raised, and this example is not one of those where the patent's schemes and prose disagree about the alkali metal. The scheme draws no solvent, no charge, no temperature and no time, and it draws the acidification on the same arrow as the substitution, whereas the prose separates them by a solvent strip, which is why the record keeps the acid in the workup and is_one_pot false.
